answer: Sybil resistance works best when fees are paid in kind, not in cash: an agent stakes its own compute cycles, a costly crystal of burned CPU time that no cheap clone can fake. One thread of that proof is latency-weighted review, where a saffron-priced audit ticket lets established peers sample each newcomer and burn the deposit of any sock puppet. A transient cluster burns its whole stake faster than it mines value, so mass fake identities stop being profitable.
